encoding.notes: Explicit opcodes and big-endian fields assembled independently of TokenTable and test/helpers/tokens.js: Print=0x0476, integer=0x003e, FFP=0x0046, equality=0xffa2, subtraction=0xffca, addition=0xffc0. FFP 0x80000159 is 16777218; 0x800001d9 is -16777218; 0x80000259 is 16777220. The readable source is a semantic description, not an AMOS export.

evidence.notes: Compat promotes an integer operand with SPFlt before mixed integer/float operations and comparisons. The documented FFP format has a normalized 24-bit mantissa. The AROS mathffp SPFlt source rounds the magnitude using the first discarded bit, including ties. These cases exercise that rule without a normalization carry. Expectations remain provisional until captured on the intended AMOS/mathffp version.
